name: livingruntime-remote
description: Bounded SSH-backed remote development tools for user-controlled hosts, available through local stdio and a public OAuth-protected MCP endpoint.

interface.longDescription: Remote development plugin for user-controlled machines. Verify connectivity, inspect configured projects, read and edit files within allowed roots, run bounded Git and built-in development commands, request operator approval for additional exact commands, and inspect allowlisted services and logs. Public ChatGPT and Codex access uses the production OAuth-protected MCP service.
defaultPrompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote connection_status to verify the host, then show repository status with git.
Read the current service logs with logs and inspect the matching source file with read_file.
